pages.text: $(thing)Positioned Processing/$ is a processing/crafting recipe type that uses $(item)Positioned Package Distributors/$ to distribute items into separate inventories.$(p)When encoded, outputs will be sorted and stacked.$(p)When unpackaged, items will be inserted into target inventories in the encoded order.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use, bind $(item)Distributor Markers/$ to inventories, and put the markers into the slots of the distributor corresponding to the encoded input slots.

pages.title: Usage (cont.)
pages.text: You can $(thing)$(k:sneak) + $(k:use)/$ a bound $(item)Distributor Marker/$ or place in a crafting grid to unbind.$(p)You can $(thing)$(k:sneak) + $(k:use)/$ with an empty hand on a $(item)Positioned Package Distributor/$ to show its current range and targets.$(p)You can combine a bound $(item)Distributor Marker/$ with unbound ones in a crafting grid to copy contents.

pages.title: Usage (cont.)
pages.text: If placed next to an $(l:core/unpackager)Unpackager/$, the $(item)Positioned Package Distributor/$ will respect its blocking mode settings; if used with a $(l:recipe/crafting_proxy)Package Crafting Machine Proxy/$, blocking mode will be off.$(p)If any target inventories become invalid, the distributor will eject all pending items on top of itself.

pages.title: Settings Cloning
pages.text: Using the $(l:core/settings_cloner)Packaging Settings Cloner/$, you can copy and paste current target setting of a $(item)Positioned Package Distributor/$.$(p)To paste target settings, you must have enough empty $(item)Distributor Markers/$ in your inventory.

pages.title: AE2 Integration
pages.text: The $(item)Positioned Package Distributor/$ can be connected to an $(thing)ME Network/$.$(p)It will instead eject pending items into the network if any target inventory becomes invalid.
